name: Burning and Suppression of Solids
objectives: Compare normal-gravity flammability testing, ground-based microgravity tests, and actual material flammability in microgravity

hypothesis.description: With adequate ventilation, materials in microgravity may burn as well as or better than the same materials in normal gravity under otherwise identical conditions.
